title: Low-angle fashion study
content:
Create a dramatic cinematic low-angle photorealistic fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman, around 28 years old, seated confidently in a dark brown leather armchair inside an elegant private study.
CAMERA: extreme low-angle fashion-editorial viewpoint from near floor level, looking upward. Wide-angle cinematic feel, realistic anatomy.
ENVIRONMENT: dark wood paneling, bookshelves, warm table lamp, brass details, traditional rug, leather armchair with nailhead trim.
LIGHTING: warm cinematic indoor lighting, soft golden key, amber practicals, subtle rim on hair.
STYLE: high-end fashion editorial, realistic skin texture, detailed satin and leather. No text, no watermark.
